title: The padding law is a check now

text: Sixty-eight pages had text touching an edge at some width; four do now. The cause was one rule (a page's inset was a grid column, and the table-of-contents rail replaced the grid above 1312px) plus three of the same shape, each fixed once. Any minion can run node Server/padding-check.mjs on its page before landing, and the health watcher now measures at 3440 too — it had only ever looked at 1280, just under where the bug began.
